cards.title: Libro abierto y escultura de cristal sobre escritorio marfil
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. An open linen-bound book and a single faceted clear glass sculpture on a pale ivory writing desk, late morning window light, architectural shadows, human thought and deliberate attention, warm paper, restrained violet reflection, exquisite editorial still life, ample negative space on the left.
